ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_EFF_TERM_DATES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_eff_term_dates ( eff_date in date,
 term_date in date,
 from_where in varchar2 ) 
IS
 dt_chk boolean;
 chp_sysdate DATE;
begin
 
 if eff_date is null then
 show_error('5002');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE);
 
 if eff_date < trunc(chp_sysdate) and from_where = 'E' then
 show_error('5015');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 if term_date is not null then
 if term_date < trunc(chp_sysdate) then
 show_error('3115');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 dt_chk := check_from_to_date(eff_date,term_date);
 if dt_chk then
 null;
 else
 show_error('5004');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: POPULATE_TABLE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE populate_table (pl_survey_cat_code in varchar2) IS
local_date date;
cursor data_cur(pl_filter in number) is 
 select 'M' code, 'Male' Description from dual where 1=pl_filter union 
 select 'F' code, 'Female' Description from dual where 1=pl_filter 
 UNION
 select donation_type code, DESCRIPTION from valid_donation_types
 where local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date, local_date+10) and 2=pl_filter
 UNION
 select procedure_code code, DESCRIPTION from valid_proc_codes
 where local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date, local_date+10) and 3=pl_filter
 UNION 
 select distinct zip code, city description from valid_city_state 
 where 4=pl_filter --and local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date, local_date+10) and 4=pl_filter
 UNION 
 select distinct template_id code, type_of_survey description from valid_survey_ques_templates 
 where local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+10) and 5=pl_filter order by 1;
 
 open_sql_number NUMBER:=0;
BEGIN
 
 local_date:=lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate);
 :GLOBAL.SURVEY_CAT:=null;
 If pl_survey_cat_code='SEX' then 
 open_sql_number:=1;
 Elsif pl_survey_cat_code='DON' then 
 open_sql_number:=2;
 Elsif pl_survey_cat_code='PROC' then 
 open_sql_number:=3;
 ElsIf pl_survey_cat_code='ZIP' then 
 open_sql_number:=4;
 ElsIf pl_survey_cat_code='SURVEY' then 
 open_sql_number:=5; 
 :GLOBAL.SURVEY_CAT:='SURVEY';
 End If;
 
 FOR Z in data_cur(open_sql_number) Loop
 :LOV_BLOCK.code:=Z.code;
 :LOV_BLOCK.code_desc:=Z.DESCRIPTION;
 NEXT_RECORD;
 End loop;
 SYNCHRONIZE;
 first_record;
 
END;

PROCEDURE duplicate_check IS
 nCOunt NUMBER:=0;
 l_date date;
BEGIN
 l_date:=lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate);
 
 select nvl(count(*),0) into nCount from survey_criteria_parm where
 survey_group_id=:scp.survey_group_id and survey_category_code=:scp.survey_category_code
 and l_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date, l_date+10);
 
 If nCount > 0 then 
 show_error('13002');
 check_package_failure;
 End If;
 
END;
